How Chimney Inspections Work

From arrival to customer report delivery—all on your phone

1

Navigate to Property

Tech opens the job on their phone, navigates to the property in the app. Property history, previous inspection notes, and chimney specs are right there.

Step 1 Visualization

2

Access Chimney Tab

Select the Chimney tab to view all chimneys on the property. Each chimney has its own inspection history, specifications, and maintenance records.

Step 2 Visualization

3

Start Inspection

Choose inspection level (CSIA Level 1, 2, or 3). The CSIA-compliant checklist loads with every required inspection point. Check off items as you go.

Step 3 Visualization

4

Document Conditions

Take photos of flue, crown, cap, and interior conditions. Log creosote stage, note any defects, cracks, or safety concerns. Add detailed notes for each finding.

Step 4 Visualization

5

Generate Report

Complete the inspection and tap Generate Report. App creates a professional PDF with all photos, findings, creosote tracking data, and CSIA compliance details.

Step 5 Visualization

6

Send to Customer

Send report directly from the app via email or text. Customer receives inspection results immediately. Create quotes for recommended repairs on the spot.

Step 6 Visualization

Everything You Need for Professional Inspections

Comprehensive tools designed specifically for chimney inspection workflows

CSIA-Compliant Checklists

Pre-loaded with official CSIA Level 1, 2, and 3 inspection checklists. Every item, every standard, built right into the app—no paper forms or clipboards needed.

Creosote Tracking

Log creosote buildup levels, document stages 1-3, and track changes over time. See historical data for repeat customers to identify patterns and recommend cleaning schedules.

Photo Documentation

Capture photos of chimney conditions, flue liners, caps, crowns, and creosote buildup. Attach directly to inspection reports with timestamps and location data.

Instant Client Delivery

Send complete inspection reports directly to customers via email or text the moment you finish. Include photos, findings, and recommendations in a professional PDF.

Branded PDF Reports

Generate professional inspection reports with your company logo, contact info, and licensing details. Reports are automatically formatted to CSIA standards.

Offline Capability

Complete inspections even without internet connection. Data syncs automatically when you are back online—perfect for rural properties or basements with poor signal.
